reason: The README clearly describes an agent-callable compiler that converts SVG paths and layered animation specifications, including images and text, into self-contained Lottie JSON assets.

summaries.zh: 将 SVG 路径和图层动画规格编译为可用于 Web、iOS 和 Android 的自包含 Lottie JSON 动画资源。
summaries.en: Compiles SVG paths and layered animation specifications into self-contained Lottie JSON assets for web, iOS, and Android.

capabilities: Parse SVG path data into Lottie shape values
Compile layer specifications into Lottie JSON animation documents
Embed PNG image data from specified file paths as base64
Write generated Lottie JSON files to local paths
